response.overview: After his brother mysteriously disappears, a man becomes convinced a ghost named Lagandi is the one to blame. Determined to find out what happened, he goes on a hunt around town to try to track down this ghost once and for all.  The Ghost of Lagandi is a mockumentary about obsession and wasting time on things that don't need focus.
response.tagline: Some mysteries are better left unsolved.
response.title: The Ghost of Lagandi
